LanguageData.SO_Intro: Right-click with a colonist selected to give these orders. Our options appear only where the game's own option is missing or greyed out.
LanguageData.SO_SetWork: Work you are not assigned to
LanguageData.SO_SetWorkTip: "Order: …" for any work on the clicked thing, even when the colonist's priority for that work is off. He must still be capable of it.
LanguageData.SO_SetResearchTip: Start researching the current project right now.
LanguageData.SO_SetSleep: Sleep / rest in a bed now
LanguageData.SO_SetSleepTip: Sleep in the clicked bed even when not tired; rest in a hospital bed.
LanguageData.SO_SetRelax: Relax at a joy building now
LanguageData.SO_SetRelaxTip: TV, chess, horseshoes and other joy buildings, even outside free time.
LanguageData.SO_SetOneClick: One click: right-click does it at once
LanguageData.SO_SetOneClickTip: A right-click on a bed puts the colonist to sleep there, on a work bench he works its bills, on a research bench he researches, on a TV or chess table he relaxes – no menu. Ctrl + right-click opens the full menu.
